name: zinput_bind_group_list_get_count
description: zInput::BindGroupList_GetCount returns zero for an unallocated bind-group pointer array and otherwise returns the pointer count.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x42a480 passed with compiler profile vc5_o2_ob0_facs, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022, flags /nologo /TP /W3 /G5 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs /I ., and zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x42a480 returns zero when g_zInput_BindGroupInfoList.begin is null; otherwise it subtracts begin from end and divides by four pointer bytes.
Native smoke verifies the empty-list zero path and a one-entry list count through zInput::BindGroupList_GetCount.
